subject: Galaga Challenge
text: Players are welcomed with a game of Galaga while the CD is loading presenting a Challenge Stage in which you must shoot 40 enemies before advancing to the next Bonus Stage, there are 8 total.

evidence.quote: Players are welcomed with a game of Galaga while the CD is loading...You will be presented with a Challenge Stage in which you must shoot 40 enemies before advancing to the next Bonus Stage, there are 8 total.

subject: Devil Kazuya
object: Defeat Galaga with a minimum of one continue, 18.5 seconds or under grants dual ship
text: You will gain access to Devil Kazuya if you defeat Galaga with a minimum of one continue, best done if you clear the opening stage in 18.5 seconds or under to grant another ship.

evidence.quote: You will gain access to Devil Kazuya if you defeat Galaga with a minimum of one continue. This is best done if you clear the opening stage in 18.5 seconds or under, which will grant you another ship (double shooter).

subject: All Characters
object: All bosses can be accessed once defeated in Arcade mode
text: All bosses can be accessed once defeated, each character has his/her own mid-level boss with Heihachi Mishima being the last.

evidence.quote: All bosses can be accessed once defeated...Each character has his/her own mid-level boss with Heihachi Mishima being the last.

subject: Heihachi Mishima
object: Defeat him and all characters without using continues
text: To access Heihachi, you must defeat him and all the characters before him without using continues, you may use any character in doing so.

evidence.quote: To access Heihachi, you must defeat him and all the characters before him without using continues, you may use any character in doing so.

subject: Difficulty Settings
object: Easy, Medium, Hard, Very Hard, Ultra Hard
text: Options Mode provides five difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Very Hard, and Ultra Hard.

evidence.quote:
Difficulty Level:

	There are five difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Very Hard, and
	Ultra Hard.

subject: Fight Count
text: Fight Count determines the number of rounds you must win to defeat your opponent, allowing you to choose any round from 1 to 5.

evidence.quote:
Fight Count:

	Determines the number of rounds you must win to defeat your opponent.
	Settings allow you to choose any round from 1 to 5.

subject: Character Change At Continue
object: Yes allows changing character on continue, No restricts to starting character
text: Character Change At Continue when turned to 'Yes' allows you to change characters when you lose in 'Arcade' mode, while 'No' only allows your starting character.

evidence.quote:
Character Change At Continue:

	When turned to 'Yes' this allows you to change characters when you
	lose in 'Arcade' mode. Otherwise 'No' will only allow you to choose
	the character you started with in 'Arcade' mode.
